limits: Counts include patients and controls; diagnostic patient totals cannot be inferred from arbitrary task labels.
Identity namespace entries are not a guarantee of globally unique people across anonymous releases.
Stored-signal hours sum recording/trial duration, never multiply channels; cross-release partial overlaps may remain.
Raw source bytes were not all reread; every selected NPZ was reread and signal-hashed.
Dataset full-scale correctness is not established solely by a passing file-format/hash validator.
UCDDB native ADC outputs are complete as quarantine derivatives but remain outside physical-scale disease totals.
New Albrecht and ADSZ AD branches use explicitly inferred microvolt conventions and are excluded from the confirmed-unit pool.
ADSZ AD file-to-person mapping and 18 Singh2021 ON/OFF sessions remain unresolved; they are not reported as independently verified people.
Possible shared Iowa participants are conservatively grouped for splitting without claiming a confirmed global person merge.

unit_confirmed_joint.note: documented/header-verified physical unit plus traceable identity; QC flags and missing diagnostic labels remain explicit

modma_native.format: NPZ native_source_integers int64 [time,3]; sampling_rate_hz 250; no signed/unsigned reinterpretation, calibration or /100

integrity_evidence.scan_method: Incremental composition: previous 255471 full-array scans reused by immutable part SHA256; every new array fully reread, finite-scanned and signal-hashed; new source bytes independently checksum-verified
